STORY-FEAT4-014.title: Define Provider Detail Response Schema and Contract
STORY-FEAT4-014.description: Create a structured response contract for provider details including NPI metadata, address, taxonomy, and external links. Ensure compatibility with tool_models and downstream consumers.

STORY-FEAT4-015.title: Expose Provider Detail Lookup via Tool Router/API
STORY-FEAT4-015.description: Register provider detail lookup as an allowed tool in tool_router with input validation and ensure it can be invoked through the FastAPI endpoint for conversational use.

STORY-FEAT4-016.title: Integrate Provider Detail Lookup into EvaluateCare Facade
STORY-FEAT4-016.description: Wire provider_detail_service into evaluate_care_facade to enable orchestrated retrieval of provider details as part of Evaluate Care workflows.
